lines.en: I run like something thrown.
The floor screams under my feet.
I lean so far forward I nearly fall.
I do not walk; I dart.
I do not slow at corners.
The cloth bellies out in the wind.
My limbs swing wildly.
I bounce off the corridor walls.
My shadow outruns me.
Three taps and I am gone.

lines.zh: 我越过一张倒下的桌子
lines.en: I vault a fallen table.
A trail of creaks follows me.
Head tilted, I pant.
My eyes glow wrong.
Standing, my limbs still twitch.

lines.zh: 我跑起来很快，你听见了吗。
lines.en: I move fast. Hear that?
I raise a hand as if to grab.
My jaw sags a little.
I smell the living.
I spin once on the spot.
Head tilted, I look at you very close.
You cannot get away.
I smile when you back away.
Let us play a game.
Your breathing is so fast.
I close on you step by step.
That way behind you is a dead end.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，从监控里就是。
lines.en: I've been watching you, from the cameras too.
A tear in the cloth.
I lurch, then right myself.
I pull back, laughing louder.
Something rattles inside.
I feel no pain, only emptiness.
My leg bends slightly wrong.
I shudder as if jammed.
I can still run.
Food? I do not need it.
Your hand shakes holding that.
I reach, then pull back.
That will not buy anything.
I bite it and spit it out.
Empty inside, empty outside.
I bat it to the floor.
I do not know why you offer it.
It smells too clean.
I hit you and rebound.
I am light, but fast.
After the hit I change direction.

lines.zh: 我的关节撞在你护甲上
lines.en: My joints clatter on your armor.
Do not stand in the middle of the corridor.
I hit the doorframe and keep smiling.
We both sway from it.
I skim past your feet.
That tipped my head sideways.
A doll has no need of that.
I can only chase, never stay.
If you cannot catch me, forget it.
I am only comfortable in the dark.
Such words make me want to run more.
My hands are not for holding.
Company? One is enough.
My laugh shows no meaning.
You had best not follow me.
I only want to run.
I snatch it up and run.
What is in my hands does not matter.
I snatch it without looking.
It dropped; I do not stop.
I hug it into a wall.
This makes noise; I like it.
I throw it to someone else.
My hands do not grip well.
I forget about it while running.
I have found you.
Let us begin.
Do not think you will reach the door.
I am much faster than you.
I have your scent stored.
I have been waiting for someone.
Every door on this floor is locked.

lines.zh: 你不该在这种时候进来
lines.en: You should not have come in now.

lines.zh: 我的轮子碾过地上的纸屑。
lines.en: My wheels roll over the scraps on the floor.
Will you run? Run, then.
Let me smile for you.
It is only the two of us.
Do not make a sound.
I have been behind you all along.
Did you hear that creaking?
I run along the wall.

lines.zh: 你每过一个门，我就近一点
lines.en: Every door you pass, I am nearer.
I do not breathe, so I never tire.
You are counting the rooms left.
Your light does not reach me.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，从另一头来
lines.en: I circle and come from the other side.
I follow your footsteps.
I can come along the ceiling.
I stop and listen for you.
You shut the door. Good.
I wait for you to understand.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候会看见我
lines.en: When you turn, you will see me.
My hand grows nearer to you.

lines.zh: 我一直在跑，也一直在近
lines.en: I keep running, and keep closing in.
Your shoulders are shaking.
I laughed; you did not hear.
The last ten steps.
I slam into you head first.
My nails rake your arm.
Light, but very sudden.
I burst out from the side.
I bite; my teeth are uneven.
One hit and you stagger.

lines.zh: 我的关节打在你护甲上
lines.en: My joints strike your armor.
I dart away again.
Does that count as a cheap shot?
I do not stop, striking in circles.
My fingers reach a bit far.

lines.zh: 你看见我的时候已经晚了
lines.en: By the time you see me, it is late.
My hands shake with laughing.
I misjudged that one.
Water on the floor; I slipped.
I hit the door loudly.
My hand caught your hem.
The corner is here, you cannot back further.
I pant, though I need not.
I am an inch from you.
I tumble out of the vent.

lines.zh: 灯泡闪了一下，我就在了
lines.en: The bulb flickered; here I am.
First I bang into a wall.
My head is crooked, not yet righted.
I hear talking.
I get up, quickly.
The corridor is empty.
I laugh once; nobody is here.
The lights dim as I appear.
I stand pressed to the wall.
The fur curls up in fire.
I fall and roll half over.
Water soaks the cloth heavy.
The blast flings me to the wall.

lines.zh: 那力量让我里面的东西乱转
lines.en: That force spins what is inside me.
I do not eat, but I come apart.

lines.zh: 电走过我的骨架，我抽起来
lines.en: Current runs my frame and I jerk.
I am falling, and still running.
